'''Ippei''' (Japanese: '''イッペイ''' ''Ippei'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|XY}} who first appeared in person in ''[[XY099|The Legend of the Ninja Hero!]]''. He is the older brother of [[Sanpei]] and [[Nihei]] and hails from [[Ninja Village]]. Ippei is the strongest ninja of the village, as well as the village's current chief.

==History==
[[File:Sanpei Froakie.png|left|thumb|250px|Ippei and his brothers]]
Ippei was first mentioned by Sanpei in ''[[XY017|A Rush of Ninja Wisdom!]]'', and was only featured in a fantasy. 

Ippei physically debuted in ''[[XY099|The Legend of the Ninja Hero!]]'', where he was making preparations for the annual village festival. He then welcomed Sanpei, when he returned to the village accompanied by {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. While watching a [[Pokémon battle]] between Sanpei and Nihei, he analyzed the battle and later commented on Sanpei's mistakes. Later, Ippei and Nihei met Sanpei, Ash, and his friends in the temple dedicated to the village's heroes. He told the group about the legend of the Pokémon that had protected the village once, when a battle between ninjas took place, and showed them the leader of the heroes, a {{p|Greninja}}.

When the attack on village began, Ippei sent Sanpei, Ash, and his friends to protect the village's chief, {{kal|Hanzo}}, while he and Nihei went to face the ninja army. After discovering that Hanzo had been captured, Ippei joined the others to hear [[Saizo]] tell about [[Kagetomo]]. After discovering Hanzo's location, [[Otori Mountain]], everyone decide to head there and save him. 

[[File:Ippei leader.png|left|thumb|250px|Ippei becomes the leader of Ninja Village]]
In [[XY100|the next episode]], the group arrived at Otori Mountain. Ippei and Saizo continued on towards the mountain's summit, while the others fought [[Heidayu]] and the ninja army. At Otori Mountain's summit, Ippei personally faced Kagetomo and had a battle over the title of chief. During the course of the battle, Hanzo saw Ippei's potential as chief. After a hard-fought battle, Ippei managed to win, defeating Kagetomo and his ninja army. Finally, when the festival took place, Ippei was chosen as the new chief of the village. He was handed the Symbol of the Ninja by Hanzo, as proof of his new position. After the ceremony, Ippei bade farewell to Kagetomo and Heidayu and promised Kagetomo to look after his ninjas.

The next day, he said goodbye to Ash and his friends. After their departure, he, Hanzo, Sanpei, Nihei, Saizo, and [[Shinobu]] had a conversation about the mysterious power of [[Ash's Greninja]]. Ippei mentioned that, again, in the words of the legend, a Greninja had saved the village.

==Character==
Ippei is quick-thinking and perceptive, leading him to instantly take charge of a situation as he did in ''[[XY099|The Legend of the Ninja Hero!]]'' when the Ninja Corps first attacked [[Ninja Village]]. He is otherwise quietly spoken and humble in his approach. He also possesses a lot of strength and is determined, like his brothers, to protect his hometown from harm.
